apis.name: Open-Meteo
apis.description: Free, open-source weather API for non-commercial use. No API key, no signup. Provides current weather, forecasts, historical data, and air quality.

rate_limits.notes: Non-commercial use only on the free tier

code_examples.python:
import requests
r = requests.get('https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast', params={'latitude': 52.52, 'longitude': 13.41, 'current_weather': True})
print(r.json()['current_weather'])

gotchas.text: Free tier is non-commercial use only
Has a separate marine, air-quality, and historical archive at different subdomains

apis.name: wttr.in
apis.description: Console-friendly weather service that also returns JSON. Perfect for terminal apps and quick scripts.

rate_limits.notes: Soft fair-use; back off on errors

gotchas.text: No CORS headers — cannot be called directly from browser JS
Slow on first hit while it caches

apis.name: US National Weather Service
apis.description: Official US government weather forecasts, alerts, and observations. Free, no key, no rate limits beyond fair-use.

rate_limits.notes: Identify yourself with a User-Agent containing contact info

gotchas.text: US territory only
Requires a User-Agent header identifying your app
No CORS — proxy required for browser apps

apis.name: 7Timer!
apis.description: Numerical weather forecasts derived from open meteorological models. Astronomy-friendly outputs (cloud cover, seeing, transparency).

code_examples.javascript:
// CORS not supported — call from server
const r = await fetch('https://www.7timer.info/bin/api.pl?lon=113.17&lat=23.09&product=astro&output=json');

gotchas.text: No CORS
Old-style CGI URL structure
Forecast resolution is coarse compared to commercial APIs

apis.name: OpenWeatherMap
apis.description: Popular weather API with current conditions, forecasts, historical data, and air pollution. Generous free tier after signup.

gotchas.text: New API keys can take up to 2 hours to activate
Default temperature unit is Kelvin (use units=metric or imperial)
One Call API requires CC even for free tier

apis.name: Visual Crossing Weather
apis.description: Hourly, daily, and historical weather data with a free tier. No credit card required for the free 1,000 records/day.

rate_limits.notes: 1,000 records per day free, no CC

gotchas.text: Free tier is for non-commercial use only
Each location-day costs 1 record

apis.name: Nominatim (OpenStreetMap)
apis.description: Geocoding and reverse-geocoding from OpenStreetMap data. Free public instance with strict fair-use limits.

gotchas.text: Max 1 request per second — abuse will get you IP-banned
Requires a User-Agent header identifying your app
Self-host for higher volume

apis.name: ip-api.com
apis.description: IP geolocation including country, region, city, timezone, ISP, and ASN. Free tier without signup.

rate_limits.notes: 45 requests per minute per source IP

code_examples.javascript:
const r = await fetch('http://ip-api.com/json/8.8.8.8');
console.log(await r.json());

gotchas.text: Free tier is HTTP only — will be blocked from HTTPS pages by mixed-content policy
HTTPS access requires a paid Pro plan

apis.name: REST Countries
apis.description: Comprehensive country metadata: names, currencies, capitals, languages, flags, borders, and more.

gotchas.text: v2 was deprecated — make sure your URL uses /v3.1
Use ?fields= to limit response size for performance

apis.name: ipapi.co
apis.description: IP geolocation with country, city, ASN, currency, and language hints. Free tier with daily quota.

code_examples.javascript:
const r = await fetch('https://ipapi.co/json/');
console.log(await r.json());

gotchas.text: Aggressive rate-limit on the free tier — 1,000/day is shared per source IP
Returns 429 with a paid-plan upsell when you hit the limit

apis.name: OpenCage Geocoding
apis.description: Forward and reverse geocoding aggregating multiple open data sources. Generous free tier with no credit card.

gotchas.text: Daily quota resets at UTC midnight, not your local timezone

apis.name: Mapbox
apis.description: Maps, geocoding, navigation, and tile serving. Generous free tier with usage-based billing after.

gotchas.text: Requires credit card for any meaningful use, even if you stay in the free tier
Map tiles count separately from geocoding requests

apis.name: CoinGecko
apis.description: Cryptocurrency prices, market cap, exchange data, and historical charts. Public tier without an API key.

gotchas.text: Public tier rate limits are not officially documented and shift over time
Higher quota plans (Demo/Pro) require signup and use a different host

apis.name: CoinPaprika
apis.description: Cryptocurrency market data API with no signup required. Covers prices, exchanges, OHLC, events, and more.

gotchas.text: Coin IDs use a slug format (btc-bitcoin) — not just the symbol

apis.name: ExchangeRate-API (Open)
apis.description: Free, open foreign-exchange rates updated daily. No signup required for the open endpoint.

gotchas.text: Rates update once per day at UTC 00:00
The non-open endpoint requires signup and a separate key

apis.name: Frankfurter
apis.description: Free forex rates from the European Central Bank. Open-source, no signup, daily updates.

gotchas.text: The old api.frankfurter.app domain redirects — use api.frankfurter.dev/v1
Only ECB-tracked currencies are supported (~30)

apis.name: Alpha Vantage
apis.description: Stock, forex, and crypto market data. Free API key after signup.

rate_limits.notes: 5 calls/min and 25 calls/day on the free tier

gotchas.text: Free tier is only 25 calls per day — extremely tight
Returns 200 OK even when rate-limited, with an error message in the JSON body

apis.name: Twelve Data
apis.description: Real-time and historical market data: stocks, forex, crypto, indices, ETFs. Free tier 800 req/day.

gotchas.text: Real-time data limited on free tier — most quotes are 15-min delayed

apis.name: USGS Earthquake Catalog
apis.description: Real-time and historical earthquake data from the US Geological Survey. GeoJSON output.

gotchas.text: Maximum response size is 20,000 events per query — paginate with starttime/endtime

apis.name: NASA APIs
apis.description: Astronomy Picture of the Day, Mars rover photos, near-Earth objects, and more. Free DEMO_KEY for low-volume use.

gotchas.text: DEMO_KEY is shared across the planet — for any production use, get your own free key

apis.name: FBI Wanted
apis.description: Public access to the FBI's wanted-persons database including fugitives, missing persons, and seeking-info cases.

gotchas.text: pageSize maximum is 50
Image URLs in the response sometimes 404 for old cases

apis.name: Open Notify (ISS)
apis.description: Real-time location of the International Space Station and current crew on board.

gotchas.text: HTTP only — will be blocked from HTTPS sites by mixed-content policy
Run by a single volunteer; occasional downtime

apis.name: UK Police Data
apis.description: Crime, stop-and-search, and police force data for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland.

gotchas.text: Data is published monthly; recent crime data has a 1-2 month lag

apis.name: Wikipedia REST API
apis.description: Page summaries, page HTML, search, and references from Wikipedia. Free, no key.
apis.example_response: {"title":"Albert Einstein","extract":"Albert Einstein was a German-born theoretical physicist..."}

gotchas.text: Set a descriptive User-Agent or Wikimedia may rate-limit you
Each language has its own subdomain (en, fr, ja, etc.)

apis.name: Disease.sh
apis.description: COVID-19 and other disease data from multiple sources, aggregated. Free and open-source.

gotchas.text: Some upstream data sources stopped reporting after 2023; freshness varies by endpoint

apis.name: ipify
apis.description: Returns the public IP of the requesting client. Tiny, fast, no key.

apis.name: DNS JSON
apis.description: DNS lookups (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, etc.) over HTTPS in JSON.

gotchas.text: Returns 200 OK with empty records when domain doesn't exist — check records.length

apis.name: is.gd
apis.description: URL shortener with a clean JSON/XML/plain API. No signup.

gotchas.text: No way to delete or edit a created short URL
Returns errors as 200 OK with an errorcode field — check response shape

apis.name: httpbin.org
apis.description: HTTP request and response service for testing clients. Echoes headers, supports every method, and simulates status codes.

code_examples.javascript:
const r = await fetch('https://httpbin.org/get?test=1');
console.log(await r.json());

gotchas.text: Public instance occasionally has slow response times
For private/CI use, run kennethreitz/httpbin in Docker

apis.name: UUID Tools
apis.description: Generate UUIDs (v1, v3, v4, v5) via a simple HTTP endpoint.

gotchas.text: For most apps, generate UUIDs locally — calling an API for this is overkill

apis.name: JSONbin.io
apis.description: Free JSON storage as a service. Create bins, version them, share via API.

code_examples.javascript:
const r = await fetch('https://api.jsonbin.io/v3/b', { method:'POST', headers:{'X-Master-Key':'{{API_KEY}}','Content-Type':'application/json'}, body:JSON.stringify({hello:'world'}) });
console.log(await r.json());
code_examples.python:
import requests
r = requests.post('https://api.jsonbin.io/v3/b', json={'hello':'world'}, headers={'X-Master-Key':'{{API_KEY}}'})
print(r.json())

gotchas.text: Free tier bins are public unless marked private (counts against quota differently)

apis.name: JSONPlaceholder
apis.description: Fake REST API for prototyping. Posts, comments, users, todos, photos. Writes are accepted but not persisted.

gotchas.text: POST/PUT/DELETE return 200/201 but don't actually persist

apis.name: DummyJSON
apis.description: Fake e-commerce-style data: products, users, posts, carts, recipes, todos, quotes, images.

gotchas.text: POSTs return a fake ID but are not persisted

apis.name: RandomUser.me
apis.description: Generate random user profiles with photos, addresses, phones, locales. Great for UI mockups.

gotchas.text: Photos are reused from a fixed pool of ~100 portraits
Results are not deterministic — add seed= for reproducibility

apis.name: Lorem Picsum
apis.description: Placeholder images at any size. Stable URLs, optional grayscale and blur.

gotchas.text: Requests redirect (302) — follow redirects in your client
Use /seed/{any-string}/200/300 for stable repeatable images

apis.name: Genderize.io
apis.description: Predict gender from a first name. Probabilistic, with confidence score.

gotchas.text: Trained on Western name datasets — accuracy is much lower for non-Western names
Returns null gender when confidence is too low

apis.name: Agify.io
apis.description: Predict age from a first name. Sibling of Genderize and Nationalize.

gotchas.text: Western dataset bias — non-Western names get sparse data and weaker predictions

apis.name: icanhazdadjoke
apis.description: Random dad jokes. Plain text or JSON depending on the Accept header.

code_examples.javascript:
const r = await fetch('https://icanhazdadjoke.com/', { headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } });
console.log((await r.json()).joke);

apis.example_response: {"id":"ly5hNR7w5Ed","joke":"I tried taking some high resolution photos...","status":200}

gotchas.text: Without Accept: application/json header, returns plain text instead of JSON
Set a User-Agent for politeness

apis.name: Official Joke API
apis.description: Random jokes with setup and punchline. Categories: general, programming, knock-knock, dad.

gotchas.text: Single maintainer, hosted on App Engine — has had multi-day outages historically

apis.name: Open Trivia DB
apis.description: 4,500+ trivia questions across 24 categories. Multiple-choice or true/false, configurable difficulty.

rate_limits.notes: 1 req/5 sec recommended; use session tokens

gotchas.text: Questions are HTML-encoded by default — set encode=url3986 or decode them
Use a session token to avoid getting the same question twice

apis.name: PokéAPI
apis.description: Comprehensive Pokémon data — species, moves, abilities, evolution chains, locations. RESTful and free.

gotchas.text: Responses are large — request only the fields you need or you'll burn through the rate limit
Cache locally; the data is essentially static

apis.name: Studio Ghibli API
apis.description: Films, characters, locations, vehicles, and species from Studio Ghibli movies.

gotchas.text: Originally hosted at ghibliapi.herokuapp.com — has migrated to Vercel

apis.name: Rick and Morty API
apis.description: Characters, episodes, and locations from the Rick and Morty TV show. RESTful, no auth.

gotchas.text: Show ended — no new data is being added

apis.name: Advice Slip API
apis.description: Returns random pieces of advice. Tiny, fast, full CORS support.

rate_limits.notes: Responses cached upstream — same advice may repeat for 1-2 sec

apis.example_response: {"slip":{"id":44,"advice":"If you are feeling down, try holding a pencil..."}}

gotchas.text: Edge cache returns the same advice for ~2 seconds — add a cache-buster param if you need uniqueness

apis.name: Pollinations.ai
apis.description: Free AI image generation via simple URL. No signup, no API key. Optional auth for higher quotas.

rate_limits.notes: Anonymous tier: ~5 req/min, queued. Sign in for higher quotas.

apis.example_response: (binary JPEG image, generated from the prompt)

gotchas.text: Anonymous tier is queued — first request can take 10-30 sec
Images may include the Pollinations watermark unless you use a paid tier

apis.name: Hugging Face Inference API
apis.description: Run hundreds of open-source models for text, image, audio, and embeddings. Free shared compute tier.

rate_limits.notes: Free tier: shared compute, rate-limited; cold-start delays

code_examples.python:
import requests
r = requests.post('https://api-inference.huggingface.co/models/distilbert-base-uncased-finetuned-sst-2-english', headers={'Authorization':'Bearer {{API_KEY}}'}, json={'inputs':'I love this!'})
print(r.json())

gotchas.text: First request to a model triggers a cold start — can take 20+ seconds
Many flagship models are now Pro-only

apis.name: Cohere
apis.description: Production-grade language models for generation, embeddings, classification, and reranking. Free trial keys.

gotchas.text: Trial keys cannot be used in production deployments per ToS

apis.name: Groq
apis.description: Extremely fast LPU inference for open-source LLMs (Llama, Mixtral, Gemma). Generous free tier.

rate_limits.notes: Free tier: 30 RPM, 14.4k RPD per model. OpenAI-compatible API.

code_examples.python:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(api_key='{{API_KEY}}', base_url='https://api.groq.com/openai/v1')
print(client.chat.completions.create(model='llama-3.1-8b-instant', messages=[{'role':'user','content':'hi'}]).choices[0].message.content)

gotchas.text: Per-model rate limits — switching models won't bypass them, they're per account
Free models change over time; check the dashboard for current list

apis.name: Google Gemini API
apis.description: Google's flagship multimodal LLM family. Free tier on Gemini Flash with reasonable limits.

rate_limits.notes: Gemini 1.5 Flash free tier: 15 RPM, 1M TPM, 1.5k RPD

gotchas.text: Free-tier inputs may be used to improve Google's models — don't send sensitive data
Region restrictions — not available in EU on free tier as of 2025

apis.name: Mistral AI
apis.description: European LLM provider with open-weight models and a free experimental tier on hosted endpoints.

rate_limits.notes: Experimental free tier on mistral-small and Pixtral-12B; per-account quotas

gotchas.text: Free tier has a default rate limit that's strict for production use
Some models require explicit opt-in in the console before they appear in API
